items.title: Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) Stock Looks Fairly Valued Despite Its 33% Slide
items.summary: Intuitive Surgical stock has had a difficult start to 2026, with the share price down 32.6% year to date, while the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate now points to a level that is broadly in line with where the market is pricing the company. The year to date decline of 32.6% raises the question of whether recent weakness is now fully reflected in the share price. Management commentary around durable demand for platforms like da Vinci 5 can support longer term cash flow...

items.title: What Do Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) Bylaw Changes Mean For Shareholders?
items.summary: Intuitive Surgical (NasdaqGS: ISRG) has approved amendments to its bylaws, updating shareholder voting rules, nomination processes, and procedural requirements in line with recent SEC universal proxy regulations. The revised bylaws clarify how proxy solicitations are conducted and what shareholders must disclose when putting forward director nominees or other proposals. The changes affect how investors can engage with the company on governance matters and may influence future proxy contests...
